basics.name: Milad Mohammadi
basics.label: Senior AI Engineer & LLM Researcher
basics.summary: Senior AI Engineer and LLM researcher with an M.Sc. in IT Engineering from the University of Tehran. My research focuses on language agents, multimodal and self-evolving language models, modeling human behavior, personalization, LLM safety, and privacy-preserving foundation models. My industry work spans production LLM agents, retrieval systems, and end-to-end AI services.

highlights: Published at EACL 2026 as second author; first-author preprint under review at NAACL 2027.
Master’s GPA: 19.14/20; ranked 1st nationwide in Iran’s IT Engineering master’s entrance exam.
3+ years of industry experience in AI engineering, including production LLM agents and RAG systems.

work.name: Adan AI
work.summary: Production LLM applications, agentic customer-service systems, Persian document retrieval pipelines, and automated FAQ chatbots.
highlights: Led the architecture and delivery of an agentic customer-service chatbot for a national bank: translated product requirements into user stories; designed a ReAct/Reflexion workflow with over 15 tool steps; implemented and reviewed LangGraph and OpenAI modules; defined and tracked production evaluation metrics.

Built a Persian PDF pipeline with table- and chart-aware parsing, chunking, and entity extraction; cut processing costs by 50% and improved retrieval accuracy by 8 percentage points on a human-annotated evaluation set.
Developed an automated FAQ chatbot generator that cleans Excel FAQs, expands seed data, and deploys chatbots without manual coding, reducing onboarding time from days to under one hour.
